# Pelagic Analytics — receivables ledger

invoices.csv lists the August invoices to UK clients; amount_gbp is the invoiced amount in pounds sterling.

Sterling receipts are settled in one batch and the proceeds reported in euros. A batch is
converted at the Aldermoor desk quotation in force on the day the batch is settled.
